name: Ueta Shoujo/Sanku no Shoujo
original_name: 飢えた少女/惨苦の少女
source:
Satsuki Toyama was raped soon after entering middle school and lost her virginity. Gradually, she starts selling herself and becomes a bully herself. Why did Satsuki turn into such an awful person? Sure, the rape was a big reason—but it wasn't the only one.

Her life is surrounded by terrible people. This is the story of Satsuki Toyama and the garbage humans around her.

Why do messed-up people become that way? The answer might seem obvious—but it's something you only really understand when you grow up.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6789]freem[/url]]
